1322-2105-4598-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
1322-2105-4598-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1322-2105-4598-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Essence Flux from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Essence Flux from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

2169-4694-5315-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2169-4694-5315-7306.description:
Activate Zameck Guildmage's first ability by paying {U}{G}, causing each creature you control to enter with an additional +1/+1 counter this turn.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Zameck Guildmage.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 2.

1981-2324-2415-2921.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Proper Burial and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Proper Burial trigger, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on them.
Repeat.

1818-1981-2415-5231.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1818-1981-2415-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.

1981-2415-2741-4050.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-2741-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.

1170-2981-5131-7729--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2981-5131-7729--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {1}
Displacer Kitten and The Vision and Scarlet Witch trigger.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the Vision and Scarlet Witch trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and adding {R}
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Megatog +3/+3 until end of turn
Repeat.

215-3443-4885.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven creature cards in your graveyard.
215-3443-4885.description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding an amount of {B} or {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Deathbloom Ritualist from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Deathbloom Ritualist by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
215-3443-4885.notes: Alternate the colors of mana you add each time. If you start adding {B}, you need {G} for Temur Sabertooth and {G} to cast Deathbloom Ritualist

1322-1368-6321-7763.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1322-1368-6321-7763.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

2173-5220-5931-6505.description:
Activate Spore Frog by sacrificing it.
When Spore Frog dies, Mortuary and Funeral Room trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Spore Frog from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Funeral Room trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Spore Frog ability.
Cast Spore Frog from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

206-1563-3129-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

855-1806-2060-2511-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Corpsejack Menace.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

104-3129-5086-5183-5231.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
104-3129-5086-5183-5231.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 1.

2919-4772-5086-5183-5231.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2919-4772-5086-5183-5231.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}
Repeat from step 1.

225-539-6845-7069.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U} due to Tectonic Split.
Cast Spider-Byte by paying its mana cost.
When Spider-Byte enters as a land due to Ashaya, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Spider-Byte trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land
Repeat.

132-1978-4002.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
132-1978-4002.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Sceptre of Eternal Glory's ability by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
If Voltaic Construct is on the battlefield, activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Myr Welder. Otherwise, activate Myr Welder using Voltaic Construct's ability by paying {2}, untapping Myr Welder.
Repeat.

67-1676-4268-5670-6917.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
67-1676-4268-5670-6917.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Reveillark.
When Reveillark dies, it triggers, returning Seedship Broodtender and Boss's Chauffeur from your graveyard to the battlefield. Boss's Chauffeur will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it equal to the number of creatures you control.
When Seedship Broodtender enters, it, Kor Celebrant and Boss's Chauffeur trigger.
Resolve the Kor Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Boss's Chauffeur trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Boss's Chauffeur.
Resolve the Seedship Broodtender trigger, causing you to mill three cards.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Boss's Chauffeur.
When Boss's Chauffeur dies, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token for each +1/+1 counter on it.
When the Citizens enter, Kor Celebrant triggers that many times, causing you to gain that much life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing a Citizen, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat step 12 two additional times.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{B}{G}.
Activate Seedship Broodtender by paying {3}{B}{G} and sacrificing it, returning Reveillark from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Reveillark enters, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.
67-1676-4268-5670-6917.notes: You must control an additional creature to get infinite +1/+1 counters on Boss's Chauffeur, infinite mana, infinite lifegain, and infinite creature tokens.

567-4593-4659-6291.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating a 1/1 Thopter and a 1/1 Phyrexian Mite artifact creature token.
When the Phyrexian Mite and Thopter enter, Soul's Attendant triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Phyrexian Mite and Thopter, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
567-4593-4659-6291.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Phyrexian Mite and/or Thopter

719-3767-3918-4851.easyPrerequisites: Trazyn the Infinite does not have summoning sickness.
719-3767-3918-4851.notablePrerequisites: Xenograft on the battlefield with "Sliver" chosen.
719-3767-3918-4851.description:
Activate Trazyn using Timeless Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2060-2313-4893-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
2060-2313-4893-5140.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

2034-4382-5003.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one enchantment.
2034-4382-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Naomi, adding {C}{C}.
When Naomi dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Naomi from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Naomi enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 2/2 Spirit creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2034-4303-4559-5272.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have a combined mana value of ten or greater.
2034-4303-4559-5272.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus, adding {C}{C}.
When Metlwork Colossus dies, Slagstone Refinery and Farid trigger.
Resolve the Slagstone Refinery trigger, creating a tapped Powerstone artifact token.
Resolve the Farid trigger, creating a Scrap artifact token.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the Powerstone token and the Scrap token, returning Metalwork Colossus from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying at most {1}.
Repeat.

1-232-1591-2232-5218.notablePrerequisites: You have a nonartifact red creature card in hand with mana value two or less.
1-232-1591-2232-5218.description:
Cast Priest of Urabrask by discarding another nonartifact red creature card with mana value two or less.
Containment Construct triggers, causing you to exile the discarded card from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it this turn.
Priest of Urabrask enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast the red creature from exile by paying its mana cost.
The creature enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Priest of Urabrask from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger from step 3, returning the red creature to your hand.
Repeat.

1916-2034-4681.description:
Cast Changeling Titan by paying {4}{G}.
Changeling Titan enters the battlefield, championing Karmic Guide.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Changeling Titan, adding {C}{C}.
Changeling Titan dies, causing Karmic Guide to return to the battlefield from exile.
Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, returning Changeling Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
